## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

- [ ] review-defenses.md exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md

- [ ] cited_lines optional field appears in Record Shape table
  Verify: grep -q 'cited_lines' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md

- [ ] Field description references ±5-line proximity matching
  Verify: grep -A3 'cited_lines' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md | grep -qiE 'proximity|±5|plus.*minus.*5|5.line'

- [ ] Field is documented as optional (no required designation)
  Verify: grep 'cited_lines' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md | grep -qiE 'no|optional'
